title: Product multilinear polynomial
statement: For a natural number $n$, a coefficient function $a$ on finite subsets of $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and a vector $x\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$, define the product multilinear polynomial recursively: in dimension zero its value is the coefficient indexed by the empty set; in dimension $n+1$, its value is $x_0$ times the polynomial in the remaining coordinates with the odd coefficients, plus the polynomial in the remaining coordinates with the even coefficients.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued coefficient function on finite subsets of $	ext{Fin}(n)$
Real-valued input vector indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n)$
